notes.title: Malware City Demo is Out Now! 🦠
notes.content:
Welcome to MalwareCity, where the system is corrupt, the files are dangerous, and survival depends on your instincts.

We’re thrilled to announce that the first playable demo of MalwareCity is available starting today on Steam!

This is just the beginning…
  This first build is our entry point into the infected system.

  Your feedback is critical to help us debug and enhance the experience. Please don’t hesitate to:
  📝 Share your impressions  📸 Post your best (or weirdest) screenshots  🐛 Report bugs and glitches  💬 Let us know what works and what doesn't

🖥️ Platform Info
  The current demo is Windows-only, but Mac and Linux versions are already in the pipeline and will be arriving soon. Stay tuned!

  Thank you for helping us shape MalwareCity. This world is full of corrupted code, rogue programs, and unstable data — and your input helps us keep the system (barely) running.

  Welcome to the grid. See you inside the code.
